groups.saying_opens: نزل جبريل صلى الله عليه وسلم فأخبرني

notes: Saying 1 (the Prophet's teaching on prayer times) runs through Ibn Shihab and Urwa. Urwa's words («فقال عروة سمعت بشير ...») are a link (rule 5, سمعت X). Umar's delay and dispute are the scene, not a link.

Abu Dawud's remarks (قال أبو داود) name other transmitters: Ma'mar and others from al-Zuhri (without the time), Hisham b. Urwa and Habib (who omit Bashir), and Wahb b. Kaysan, Abu Hurayra and Hassan b. Atiyya with Amr b. Shu'ayb. These are variant groups (rule 4). The maghrib-time chains concern another point, so they are marked variant and not routes of saying 1.
«بهذا الحديث» is not written here; the remarks are separate.
